title: Workflow Recommendation
description:
Stage 9 artifact for the existing_workflow path (FR-021, docs/15 D-40). Rendered from the Stage 6W review rather than generated, so it cannot disagree with the reasoning it reports.

STRUCTURE PRECEDES FINDINGS, structurally. FR-021's first acceptance criterion is that the output identifies the current structure before evaluating it, so current_structure is required and non-empty regardless of whether anything was found wrong.

SILENCE IS NOT SOUNDNESS. FR-021 requires a sound workflow to yield an explicit statement rather than an empty list. That rule is not expressible in JSON Schema — it is a conditional on the emptiness of findings — and is enforced in parseWorkflowReview. Schema-valid is necessary, not sufficient.

steps.description: At least one. A review of no structure is not a review.

findings.description: May be empty — a sound workflow is a valid outcome (FR-021).

step.description: The step this concerns. FR-021 rejects generic best-practice statements, and a finding naming no step is one.

remediation.description: Concrete, per FR-021. An issue with no remediation is a complaint.

soundness_statement.description: Required by FR-021 when findings is empty. The conditional is enforced by the parser, not here.
